fit_rationale: Textbook DT tokamak; ARC's R~3.3m / B~9.2T geometry is exactly what the TOKAMAK enum is calibrated for. HTS magnet stack adds REBCO cost-per-kA-m as a known driver but does not change the cost-account structure.
Acoustic-driven IFE has no analog in any ENUM; truly bespoke residual.

Laser driver fits the ENUM workflow but the gold-nanoshell + femtosecond + liquid-jet target architecture has no parallel in the ENUM's chamber/target/optics defaults. Rank-2 split → Low: target architecture is a fundamental deviation in chamber and optics cost categories, not a tunable parameter.

Laser driver fits but PB11 fuel breaks the ENUM's DT defaults (blanket/special-materials) and the per-shot consumable kT magnetic-field coil is unbudgeted hardware. Rank-2 split → Low: PB11 + consumable-coil are compounding structural deviations.
Stellarator topology + DT — direct ENUM territory; planar-coil variant is a geometry parameter the ENUM accommodates.

Mirror geometry fits but PB11 aneutronic operation with rotation-sustained DEC compounds two ENUM deviations: PB11 breaks DT blanket defaults and rotation-DEC breaks the steady-state thermal power balance the ENUM assumes. Rank-2 split → Low.
Dedicated MAGLIF ENUM covers the architecture; pulsed-power liner-compression layout is the calibration case.
FRC topology fits but INDUCTIVE_DEC + DHE3 fuel + colliding-FRC compression are three compounding deviations from the ENUM's thermal/DT defaults. Rank-2 split → Low.
Quasi-isodynamic stellarator + DT — clean ENUM territory; QI variant accommodated as a geometry parameter.
Direct stellarator + DT.

Single levitated SC coil + stationary support coils + DT — the DIPOLE ENUM's calibration case.

ENUM matches the rotating-electrode electrostatic concept family. Orbitron's specific drive architecture isn't captured beyond generic markup coefficients but the cost structure stands. Rank-2 split → Med: ENUM exists for the family; specific drive details unmodeled but framework cost rollup applies.

MAG_TARGET catch-all hosts MIF approaches by design; pneumatic-piston driver + liquid-metal vortex chamber are within the catch-all's intended scope. Rank-2 split → Med: catch-all ENUM is generic by design; deviations are absorbed.

Laser IFE fits but fast ignition uses separate compression + ignition lasers and the ENUM treats both as one driver. Rank-2 split → Med: single architectural deviation in the driver model; chamber/target/blanket/thermal accounts unaffected.

TAE's linear geometry, steady-state NBI sustainment, and end-cell DEC are mirror-like; however the FRC closed-field-line core (with its formation/sustainment hardware) sits inside the mirror trap with no direct analog, and PB11 fuel breaks DT defaults. Rank-2 split → Low: PB11 + FRC core inside mirror is compound.

Dipole magnetic topology fits the ENUM but the orbital deployment context introduces structural and launch-cost factors that have no terrestrial-plant analog in the cost rollup. Rank-2 split → Low: launch costs are an entirely new cost category outside the framework.
